service.description: Register a new user with email and password. Validates email format and uniqueness, hashes password securely, creates user with 500 initial credits, and returns JWT token on success. Requirements: 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.4, 1.5

parameter.name: email
parameter.description: User email address (must be valid format and unique)

parameter.name: username
parameter.description: Optional display name for the user

parameter.name: token
parameter.description: JWT access token (optional - will be extracted from Authorization header if not provided)
